create_sheep_from_argv: create a Sheep from command-line arguments to track a specific XP run on the cluster
check_sheep_state: check the current SLURM job state of a Sheep to see if it is running or completed
cancel_lazy_job: cancel a pending or running SLURM job lazily and commit the cancellation later
submit_job_array: submit multiple Sheep experiments as a SLURM job array with shared configuration
register_preemption_callback: register a callback function that runs when a SLURM job is preempted for checkpointing
